entities.summary: Allied Occupation and Reform, a transformative movement in Japan (1945–1952). Emerged from San Francisco Peace Treaty and San Francisco Peace Treaty — Japan regains sovereignty. Catalyzed New Japanese Constitution enacted — includes pacifist Article 9 and High Growth and Economic Miracle.
